responsibility: Declares the Linux64-specific rs6000 target options. It adds the -mprofile-kernel switch and the -mcmodel= code-model enum/variable used by the 64-bit Linux target headers and override logic, integrating these controls into GCC’s option parsing and target configuration state.
same_name_distinction: This is the Linux64 option-definition file, introducing switches such as -mprofile-kernel and -mcmodel=. Unlike linux64.h, it does not contain the ABI-selection, spec, or override logic that interprets and enforces those options.
